extensionDescription.message: Add-on that pairs Thunderbird with the local Codex Thunderbird Plugin.

statusNotPairedDetail.message: Start pairing in Codex, then enter the bridge URL and PIN.

statusPairedDetail.message: Thunderbird is polling the local Codex bridge.

accessSummaryAll.message: Codex may access all $COUNT$ Thunderbird accounts.

accessSummarySelected.message: Codex may access $SELECTED$ of $TOTAL$ Thunderbird accounts.

guideStep1.message: Install and enable the Codex extension from the GitHub repository.

guideStep2.message: In Codex, call start_pairing from Codex Thunderbird.

guideStep3.message: Paste the bridge URL and six-digit PIN here, then click Pair.

guideStep4.message: Use Manage allowed accounts to decide which Thunderbird accounts Codex may access.

installHelpText.message: Add the GitHub repository as a Codex plugin source, then install Codex Thunderbird.

errorLoopback.message: Bridge URL must be localhost or 127.0.0.1.

errorPin.message: Enter the six-digit PIN from Codex.
